model_output.cross_horizon_summary: The supplied evidence supports a downside lean over 12h and 72h, but no reliable directional edge for the 168h endpoint. Broad losses, weakening ETH/BTC, settled ETF outflows and contracting stablecoin supply outweigh localized signs of absorption. Those signs nevertheless allow sharp countertrend rebounds. Positive BTC-to-altcoin transmission remains weak and unconfirmed; microcap transmission is unavailable. The Cycle Navigator is contextual only. These are non-binding descriptive forecasts with no portfolio execution authority.
global_missing_evidence: Only one completed hourly candle and limited packet-to-packet changes are supplied; a sustained intraday price, volume and relative-strength sequence cannot be established.
Breadth and capitalization buckets share one upstream family and are not independent confirmations. Canonical broad-alt and large-cap breadth remain UNCONFIRMED.
The small-alt proxy covers only the Top-100 tail; the microcap universe is unobserved.
Latest supplied settled ETF flows cover November 18, not the current session. Unchanged packet values do not establish unchanged subsequent flows.
Stablecoin supply contraction is observed, but deployment, exchange inflows and actual buying demand are not established.
Order-book and trade-imbalance observations are single-venue snapshots. Liquidation data and realized hourly funding-event rates are unavailable.
Macro observations have different reporting lags and no supplied trend sequence; live-anchor source-observation freshness is unavailable despite passing capture freshness.
No substantive forward catalyst schedule is supplied; the catalyst source-health reference alone provides no directional evidence.

A bid-heavy snapshot or a bounce from the hourly lows would not by itself establish continuation higher.
